data.current_summary: Approve, and write a Change Event to Procore
data.current_description: Writes money into the customer's Procore. Check GET /projects/{project_id}/capability first on an unfamiliar project: without Project Financials there is no Change Events tool and this returns 409 until you pass destination daily_log. Idempotent: approving an already-written ticket returns it unchanged rather than creating a second Change Event. A previously rejected ticket can be approved, but only with allow_rejected. A line with no budget code at all is refused unless allow_unrouted is true. Set require_exact if no human is watching: it also refuses lines that merely matched a plausible code, which is the case a person would catch on screen and a program would not.
data.summary_suggestion: Approve ticket and write Change Event to Procore
data.description_suggestion: Writes the ticket's line items into Procore as a Change Event, committing costs to the customer's financials. This operation is not reversible. Before approving on an unfamiliar project, call GET /projects/{project_id}/capability to verify Project Financials is enabled; if not, pass destination=daily_log or the operation returns 409. Idempotent: re-approving an already-approved ticket returns it unchanged. Requires allow_rejected=true to approve a previously rejected ticket. Refuses line items with no budget code unless allow_unrouted=true. Set require_exact=true to reject lines that only matched a plausible code (recommended when no human review is present). Returns the approved ticket with Procore Change Event reference.
